prompt:
UNIVERSAL MOTORCYCLE → HERO ROBOT
TRANSFORMATION CHARACTER SHEET MASTER PROMPT

Analyze the provided motorcycle photograph carefully and use the motorcycle itself as the absolute visual reference.

Do not assume a motorcycle model, color palette, body style, or mechanical configuration in advance.

FIRST, visually analyze the actual motorcycle shown in the uploaded photograph.

Automatically identify and preserve its most recognizable visual characteristics, including:

motorcycle type and overall silhouette,
body proportions,
primary and secondary colors,
painted body panels,
front and rear wheels,
wheel size and thickness,
tires,
wheel rims,
front fork,
rear suspension,
engine or motor components,
exhaust system,
frame,
fuel tank or central body structure,
seat shape and material,
handlebars,
mirrors,
headlight,
tail light,
turn signals,
front and rear fenders,
cargo box or luggage equipment if present,
windscreen if present,
footboard or foot pegs,
exposed cables,
mechanical joints,
decals and graphic placement,
surface scratches,
paint wear,
 dust,
aged materials,
and other distinctive physical details visible in the reference.

The final robot must clearly retain the visual DNA of THIS EXACT MOTORCYCLE.

A viewer should immediately think:

"That robot was transformed from that motorcycle."

==================================================
CHARACTER SHEET CONCEPT
==================================================

Create a cinematic transformation character sheet showing ONE motorcycle gradually transforming into ONE humanoid heroic robot.

Show the transformation as a clear physical progression:

STAGE 1:
Original motorcycle.

The motorcycle remains almost completely unchanged and clearly recognizable.

STAGE 2:
Early mechanical activation.

Small body panels separate slightly.

Mechanical locks release.

Suspension components shift.

Internal mechanical structures become visible.

The motorcycle must still remain approximately 80–90% recognizable.

STAGE 3:
Intermediate transformation.

The wheels reposition naturally.

The chassis begins extending.

Existing motorcycle components rotate, unfold, slide and reconnect.

The beginnings of humanoid legs, torso and arms become visible.

The motorcycle remains approximately 50–70% recognizable.

STAGE 4:
Advanced transformation.

The original motorcycle body panels become armor.

Wheels integrate naturally into the robot anatomy.

The exhaust becomes a recognizable mechanical armor component.

Handlebars, mirrors, lights, suspension, frame, seat, cargo equipment and other visible motorcycle components are redistributed logically across the robot.

The humanoid silhouette becomes dominant.

STAGE 5:
COMPLETE HERO ROBOT.

A magnificent full-body mechanical hero created entirely from the visual identity of the original motorcycle.

==================================================
TRANSFORMATION PHYSICS
==================================================

The transformation must look mechanically believable.

Every major motorcycle component should have a logical destination on the final robot.

Parts rotate around realistic hinges.

Panels slide along mechanical rails.

Frames extend through telescoping structures.

Suspension components become functional mechanical joints.

Existing motorcycle components become armor rather than disappearing.

Wheels remain physically recognizable.

The exhaust remains recognizable.

The original painted panels remain recognizable.

Distinctive motorcycle accessories remain recognizable whenever physically possible.

NO instant morphing.

NO liquid-metal transformation.

NO magical replacement.

NO random teleporting parts.

NO unexplained disappearance of major motorcycle components.

NO generic robot replacing the motorcycle.

The transformation should feel slow, heavy, deliberate and physically connected.

translations.zh: 通用摩托车 → 英雄机器人变形角色设定表核心提示词。请仔细分析所提供的摩托车照片，并将其实体作为绝对视觉参考。不要预先设定摩托车款式、配色、结构，精确提取车体轮廓、配件、磨损及颜色细节。最终机器人必须完全继承该摩托车的视觉基因。创建电影级连续变形设定表，分5个阶段逐步展示摩托车从原始状态、机械激活、结构展开、机甲重构到最终完全体人形机器人的机械变形全过程，注重物理机械铰链与构件逻辑性，严禁瞬间形变或魔法替换。
translations.en: Universal motorcycle to hero robot transformation character sheet master prompt. Analyzes the provided motorcycle photo as a strict visual reference to retain its colors, parts, and wear. It outlines a five-stage realistic mechanical transformation process progressing from the original bike into a fully formed humanoid hero robot with logical physical mechanics.
